question: Does stable_log1p improve matched frozen-multiview adapter learning over unchanged standard cross entropy?

matched_training.parent_initialization: same immutable parent bytes per seed
matched_training.sampler_schedule: same deterministic seed and row order across loss arms

decision_rule: stable_log1p must beat both standard and no-intervention by more than two times pooled standard deviation on both primary metrics
claim_boundary: This bounded segment measures direction and variance. It does not replace a full-budget replication and cannot authorize promotion.
stop_conditions: baseline, parent, source, dataset, or preregistration hash mismatch
checkpoint identity or loss mode mismatch
less than 25 GiB free in the selected runtime
private or offline cloud contract not satisfied
